label: Boudoir Interior
description: Session interiors for boudoir and intimate portrait work — suites, bedrooms and studio corners, all written in the same register.

items.name: parisian-haussmann
items.text: Vintage Parisian Haussmannian apartment featuring ornate gilded boiserie moulding, French doors and aged herringbone parquet.

items.name: venetian-palace
items.text: Opulent Venetian palace suite decorated with authentic Murano glass chandeliers, damask silk wall coverings and marble balconies.

items.name: cliffside-villa
items.text: Modern minimalist cliffside villa with monochromatic concrete textures, low-profile platform seating and floor-to-ceiling ocean-view glass.

items.name: brick-studio-loft
items.text: Industrial red-brick studio loft featuring weathered masonry, exposed timber beams, warm brass accent fixtures and soft side window lighting.

items.name: hotel-penthouse
items.text: Luxury hotel penthouse suite with tufted Italian leather chesterfield sofas, polished walnut panels and city skyline windows.

items.name: corner-atelier
items.text: Sunlit corner atelier studio with floor-to-ceiling glass, sheer flowing linen drapes and warm natural sunlight bounce.

items.name: copper-spa-suite
items.text: Opulent spa suite featuring a freestanding antique copper clawfoot tub, intricate Calacatta marble tilework and brushed gold fixtures.

items.name: speakeasy-parlor
items.text: Private velvet-draped speakeasy parlor with rich oxblood damask wallpapers, carved dark walnut woodwork and brass floor lamps.

items.name: mansion-library
items.text: Historic mansion library with floor-to-ceiling dark walnut bookshelves, carved mahogany hearth and warm fireplace glow.

items.name: plaster-studio
items.text: Daylit Venetian-plaster studio featuring rich textured tonal walls, minimalist sculptural furniture and natural soft light falloff.

items.name: sunroom-conservatory
items.text: Sunroom conservatory with wrought-iron architectural windows, lush exotic tropical palms and diffused sunlight.

items.name: gallery-studio
items.text: Minimalist art gallery studio with track spotlighting, low-profile seating and clean architectural lines.

items.name: dressing-parlor
items.text: High-end dressing parlor featuring a grand Hollywood vanity mirror with warm lightbulbs, velvet stools and silk drapes.

items.name: country-estate
items.text: Rustic country estate suite with exposed natural fieldstone walls, heavy timber beams and wrought-iron candelabras.

items.name: boho-loft
items.text: Boho-chic studio loft with layered textured woven rugs, soft pampas grass and warm ambient lanterns.

items.name: noir-parlor
items.text: Moody film-noir parlor featuring dark crimson flock wallpaper, heavy velvet drapes and vintage brass fixtures.

items.name: ryokan-suite
items.text: Serene ryokan suite with tatami flooring, shoji-filtered light, a low cedar platform bed and a single ikebana arrangement in the tokonoma alcove.

items.name: art-deco-suite
items.text: Glamorous Art Deco suite with lacquered burl-wood panels, fan-motif mirrors, frosted-glass sconces and champagne velvet upholstery.

items.name: attic-skylight-loft
items.text: Converted attic loft with steep exposed rafters, a brass bed beneath a wide skylight and soft directional toplight falling across rumpled white linen.
